predict_dna_sequence: predict DNA sequence output using a DnaModel implementation with requested ontology terms
predict_multiple_dna_sequences: predict outputs for multiple DNA sequences in parallel using predict_sequences with a progress bar
predict_dna_interval: predict outputs for a genomic interval using predict_interval on a DnaModel implementation
score_dna_variant: score a DNA variant against an interval using score_variant with recommended variant scorers
score_ism_variants: generate in-silico mutagenesis variant scores for all positions in a given interval
